incoming.name: Arctic
incoming.excerpt: A similar situation may also have been found amongst dinosaurs that lived in Antarctic regions, such as Muttaburrasaurus of Australia.

outgoing.name: Cretaceous
outgoing.excerpt: Muttaburrasaurus was a herbivorous ornithopod dinosaur related to Camptosaurus and Iguanodon, from the early Cretaceous Period of what is now northeastern Australia.

outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: …found by Doug Langdon in 1963 near Muttaburra, Queensland, Australia, which place also provides the creature's name.
